name: Nextcloud

database.label: MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL recommended for production; SQLite works only for small single-user test setups

resourceFootprint.notes: 1 GB RAM / 1 core handles a small family install with a handful of users. Footprint scales with concurrent users, installed apps (Office/collabora, Talk) and file preview generation; larger deployments benefit from a Redis cache and a separate database container.

dockerComposeSnippet:
services:
  db:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: nextcloud-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: --transaction-isolation=READ-COMMITTED --log-bin=binlog --binlog-format=ROW
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/lib/mysql
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: change-me-root
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: change-me
      MYSQL_DATABASE: nextcloud
      MYSQL_USER: nextcloud

  app:
    image: nextcloud:latest
    container_name: nextcloud
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    depends_on:
      - db
    volumes:
      - nextcloud-data:/var/www/html
    environment:
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: change-me
      MYSQL_DATABASE: nextcloud
      MYSQL_USER: nextcloud
      MYSQL_HOST: db

volumes:
  db-data:
  nextcloud-data:
descriptionEn: Nextcloud is a full-featured, self-hosted productivity platform for file sync and sharing, calendars, contacts, and real-time document collaboration. With hundreds of official and community apps (Talk video calls, Office, Deck kanban boards), it goes far beyond simple cloud storage while keeping every byte of your data under your own control.
descriptionBg: Nextcloud е пълноценна self-hosted платформа за продуктивност за синхронизация и споделяне на файлове, календари, контакти и съвместна работа с документи в реално време. Със стотици официални и общностни приложения (видео разговори Talk, Office, Deck), тя предлага много повече от обикновено облачно съхранение, докато данните ти остават изцяло под твой контрол.
taglineEn: Self-hosted file sync, sharing and collaboration platform.
taglineBg: Self-hosted платформа за синхронизация, споделяне и съвместна работа с файлове.
